title: O. E. Rolvaag House, 311 Manitou Street, Northfield, Rice County, MN
notes: Significance: Home of O.E. Rolvaag, the first American novelist to give a true accounting of the psychological cost of pioneering on the farmer's frontier.  His famous trilogy - "Giants in the Earth, "Peder Victorious" & "Their Father's God" stand as the most penetrating literary assessment of the adjustments immigrant pioneers had to make to find peace and prosperity in middle America.  A Norwegian immigrant himself, he wrote most of his works here.  Hew built his house here because it was near St. Olaf College where he taught.
